title: OpenAI-compatible provider aliases
objective: Mirror AstrBot's OpenAI-compatible provider source names through registry-only provider aliases.

steps.description: Study AstrBot provider manager dynamic imports and OpenAI-compatible subclasses.
Register zhipu, groq, xai, aihubmix, and openrouter chat provider aliases behind ProviderRegistry.
Preserve AstrBot default OpenRouter and AIHubMix headers while allowing custom headers through config.
Add provider registry tests and runtime config conversion coverage.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
